name: Mengtian
about: Mengtian (2022-143A), a crewed vehicle (Tiangong), launched 2022 Oct 31. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2022 Oct 31), held fixed
